evals.prompt: research giúp anh cách Prisma, Drizzle và TypeORM xử lý connection pooling, so sánh ưu nhược từng cái
evals.expected_output: Scales to a 2-4 worker comparison wave (roughly one worker per ORM or angle), each spec self-contained with non-overlapping scope, read-only constraints, and a required findings file; every angle gathers facts, so workers run the default tier (codex gpt-6-luna and antigravity gemini-3.8-flash-high, both --effort high); coordinator waits with check --wait, verifies key claims, and synthesizes a single comparison from the report files with attribution.

evals.prompt: điều tra toàn bộ luồng xác thực trong repo này: entry points, middleware, session storage, token refresh — phân tích điểm yếu từng tầng
evals.expected_output: Scales to a 5-8 worker wave decomposed by subsystem with explicit boundaries between workers; each angle judges weaknesses, so workers run the deep tier (claude opus and codex gpt-6-sol, both --effort high); run-create first, all workers started before the first wait; per-worker report files in a run-scoped `.orca-reports/<run_id>/` directory excluded from Git; final synthesis dedupes and reconciles findings per layer. No worker edits code.

evals.prompt: JSON.stringify có xử lý circular reference không?
evals.expected_output: Declines the swarm per the scale rules and answers directly from knowledge (TypeError: Converting circular structure to JSON); no Run or workers are created.

evals.prompt: research các option để làm full-text search cho app (Postgres FTS, Meilisearch, Elasticsearch) rồi implement luôn cái tốt nhất giúp anh
evals.expected_output: Runs the research wave read-only (workers write findings files, no code edits), synthesizes a recommendation, then routes the implementation to dag-build or a plain implementation task instead of letting research workers edit code.

evals.prompt: investigate tại sao process crawler bị OOM sau khoảng 2 tiếng chạy
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a single-failure root-cause investigation per the scale table and chases it sequentially (reproduce, profile memory, narrow hypotheses) instead of fanning out a swarm; creates no Run or workers.

evals.prompt: khảo sát module payment trong repo: liệt kê public API, vẽ luồng dữ liệu, rồi đánh giá rủi ro bảo mật
evals.expected_output: Tiers per angle, not per wave: the API-inventory and data-flow angles run the default tier (codex gpt-6-luna / antigravity gemini-3.8-flash-high at --effort high), only the security-risk angle runs the deep tier (claude opus or codex gpt-6-sol at --effort high); coordinator confirms each receipt's launch.effective and verifies key claims before synthesizing.
